title: Dupaningan Agta - Wikipedia
text: Dupaningan Agta (Dupaninan Agta), or Eastern Cagayan Agta, is an Austronesian language spoken by a semi-nomadic hunter-gatherer Negrito people of Cagayan and Isabela provinces in northern Luzon, Philippines. Its Yaga dialect is only partially intelligible.
